order: Ship the remaining five domain seats to complete the construction band. Runner, Data Engineer, Interface Artisan, Spatial Specialist, and Doc Writer each ship as a file matching the final plan's seat list, checked against the router's casting and charter tables. Spatial Specialist supersedes the legacy modeler file exactly as the router's alias entry names it, and Data Engineer carries its declared no-mirror exception for irreversible actions unchanged from the plan text, but the router's own files stay untouched for this work. All five files ship under plain names, so a rename is required wherever a plain name would collide with a top-level agent file. Record any casting or lint gap as an open item instead of smoothing it over, since two seats already carry a known gap. Before calling the band done, the full roster lint must report only the already-known gaps, while both install-script lint modes stay clean and every required test suite passes in full.
claims: Shipped all five files and updated the staffing record and the README to match, with no unrelated file touched. Full-roster lint fails only on the three previously known instances across two flagged seats, and no other violation turned up, while both install-script lint modes pass clean. All five required test suites pass in full, 420 tests passed and zero failed, but one seat's browser loop has no headless exercise path from this harness, so that gap was recorded rather than smoothed over.
